blade_rpm_15.label: Rotor at 15 RPM
blade_rpm_15.description: Turbines locked at ~15.16 RPM with very tight standard deviation (<0.1). Represents rated rotor speed under moderate-to-high winds.

farm_stopped.label: Entire Farm Stopped
farm_stopped.description: All turbines at 0 kW output for the full hour. Likely a coordinated shutdown, grid request, or calm period.

high_wind_full_spin.label: High Wind – Full Spin
high_wind_full_spin.description: All 6 turbines producing near-rated power (~2 MW) simultaneously. Wind speed 11–15 m/s, low std dev — stable high-output hours.

low_wind_cutin.label: Low Wind – Cut-in Region
low_wind_cutin.description: Wind speed 3–6 m/s, all turbines just above cut-in threshold, generating 150–300 kW each. Power curve cut-in region.

partial_performance.label: Partial Performance
partial_performance.description: Farm generating power but well below rated capacity. Wide spread between turbines indicates curtailment or individual faults.
